subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

119.99 ÷ 14.99 × 25.01 - 19.98 × 4.96 = ?
solution:
**Given,**

119.99 ÷ 14.99 × 25.01 - 19.98 × 4.96 = ?

**Concept used:**

BODMAS rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Calculation: **

In approx value:

119.99 = 120

14.99 = 15

25.01 = 25

19.98 = 20

4.96 = 5

Now,

120 ÷ 15 × 25 - 20 × 5

⇒ 8 × 25 - 100

⇒ 200 - 100 = 100.

**∴ The closest approximate value of the given equation is 100.**
